OFFLINE

You start on the runway at a standstill — push the throttle up yourself to accelerate and lift off. Ease down gently over the runway to land — dive into it and it's another story.

Gold rings appear along your flight path once airborne — fly through them to bank coins and build a streak. Chain rings quickly to multiply your payout; miss one and the streak resets.
